incidents.commentary: No run.
1 run.
Keeps it full, on off, Paul Stirling blocks it to the point fielder.
Flatter, on middle and leg, Paul Stirling flicks it through short fine leg for a brace.
Fuller again, on leg, Paul Stirling taps it to mid on.
Much fuller, on off, Paul Stirling blocks it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Paul Stirling looks to flick it but the ball clips his pads and rolls fine. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller, on off, Cade Carmichael eases it to backward point for a single.
Length again, outside off, Paul Stirling cuts it through covers for yet another single.
Hard length, on off, Cade Carmichael pushes it through covers for a single.
On a length, outside off, Paul Stirling slaps it through covers for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for Ireland! A wayward bouncer, on off, Paul Stirling looks to play an uppercut but misses. The keeper fails to stop it as the ball races away.
Much fuller, on off, Paul Stirling blocks it to cover.
Maiden from Taijul Islam. Keeps it full, on leg, Cade Carmichael blocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted up, on leg, Cade Carmichael digs it to mid on.
Keeps it full, on middle, Cade Carmichael flicks it to square leg.
Quicker, on off, Cade Carmichael leans on and blocks it back.
Flighted up, on off, Cade Carmichael digs it back again.
Taijul Islam comes into the attack and bowls it on leg, Cade Carmichael blocks it back to the bowler.
Length again, on off, Paul Stirling pushes it to the left of the bowler.
On a length, outside off, Cade Carmichael punches it through covers for a single.
Back of a length, on off, Cade Carmichael fends it to the gully fielder.
On a length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it to the point fielder.
Back of a length, on off, Cade Carmichael punches it through covers for a brace.
Sways it down the leg side, Cade Carmichael leaves it alone.
FOUR! Excellent from Paul Stirling! Length again, outside off, Paul Stirling picks it well and slashes it through backward point for a boundary.
Much fuller, on off, Paul Stirling blocks it to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, just outside off, Paul Stirling stays in his crease and punches it magnificently through covers for a boundary.
Length, on leg, Paul Stirling flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, on off, Paul Stirling pushes it to cover.
On a length, down leg, Paul Stirling shuffles across and looks to punch it but misses. The ball just missed the top of leg.
Short, on leg, Cade Carmichael leaves it alone.
Length, on leg, Cade Carmichael tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Short, down leg, Cade Carmichael looks to pull it but misses.
On a length, outside off, Cade Carmichael leaves it alone.
Put down! Length, outside off, Paul Stirling looks to slap it but edges it to the gully fielder who spills another catch to his right. The batters collect a single.
On a length, on off, Paul Stirling blocks it back to the bowler.
Length, outside off, Cade Carmichael looks to drive it but gets beaten.
On a length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it to cover.
Dropped! Short, on off, Cade Carmichael pulls it to mid-wicket. The ball carries and Taijul Islam spills it to his left. That should have been taken.
On a length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it back again.
Length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it back to the bowler.
Too full, down leg, Cade Carmichael looks to flick it but wears it on his pads. A stifled appeal but turned down.
Hard length, outside off, Paul Stirling punches it through covers for a brace.
On a length, on off, Paul Stirling taps it to mid on.
Just short! On a length, on off, Paul Stirling looks to block it but gets a thick edge. The ball lands just short of the fielder at second slip. Lucky escape for Paul Stirling.
FOUR! Top shot from Paul Stirling! Short and wide, Paul Stirling reaches out to it and chips it over backward point for a boundary.
On a length, on leg, Cade Carmichael flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on leg, Cade Carmichael blocks it to the right of the bowler.
Much fuller, on leg, Cade Carmichael flicks it to mid on for a single.
Length, outside off, Cade Carmichael shoulders arms at it.
Much fuller, on leg, Cade Carmichael flicks it to mid on.
On a length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! That's a good looking shot! Hasan Mahmud errs his line down leg, Cade Carmichael stays back and flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Much fuller, on off, Paul Stirling drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and flicks the ball just in before the fence. The batters collect three runs.
Short, on off, Cade Carmichael fends it to the right of the keeper.
FOUR! Excellent way to get off the mark! On a length, on middle and leg, Cade Carmichael picks it well and tucks it magnificently in the gap through square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off, Cade Carmichael leaves it alone.
Much fuller, on off, Cade Carmichael taps it to the cover fielder.
Short and wide, with a hint of movement. Cade Carmichael leaves the harmless delivery.
On a length, on off, Paul Stirling punches it to cover for a single.
A wicket-maiden from Hasan Mahmud. Sways it down leg, Cade Carmichael looks to flick it but wears it on his pads. A stifled appeal but turned down.
On a length, on off, Cade Carmichael blocks it back to the bowler.

OUT! LBW! Hasan strikes early. The skipper departs. Much fuller, on off, and it shapes in. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and looks to drive it but misses and the ball hits his pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up straightaway. Andy Balbirnie has a chat with his partner and decides to send it upstairs. Ultra Edge shows a spike but there was a clear gap so there was clearly no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the impact was umpires call and the onfield decision will stand. Andy Balbirnie walks back for a duck.
Much fuller, on off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to the left of the bowler.
Down the leg side, Andy Balbirnie looks to flick it but misses. The keeper does well to stop it to his left. Dot.
Hasan Mahmud starts with a length ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie stays back and blocks it solidly.
